messages:
lina: Hey @support, getting repeated 400 from tool_call when passing JSON args. Body validated fine locally. Repro below, maybe related to UTF-7 encoding from a Windows client. Error: "toolargs: invalid JSON: unexpected control character"

max: Can you paste the exact request headers + body (raw)? Also which SDK/version?

lina: SDK: js-client v2.4.1 on Windows 10. Raw curl I used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @payload.json
```
payload.json contents:
```json
{"tool":"pdf_extract","args":"{+AJ0-+ACM-\"path\":+ACI-C:\\Users\\Bob\\notes.pdf+ACI-}"}
```
The inner JSON got encoded with UTF-7-ish sequences (+ACI- for ""). When I pasted from a legacy editor it converted quotes.

support-bot: Noted. That +ACI- looks like UTF-7 or modified-UTF7. Could be a mail client paste. Can you attach the actual bytes (xxd or hexdump)?

lina: Hexdump of the first 40 bytes:
```text
7b 22 74 6f 6f 6c 22 3a 22 70 64 66 5f 65 78 74 72 61 63 74 22 2c 22 61 72 67 73 22 3a 22 7b 2b 41 4a 30 2d 2b 41 43 4d 2d
```
Looks like +AJ0- +ACM- sequences.

max: Ok repro'ed locally. Our parser treats "+" sequences as valid characters but then JSON.parse on inner args fails due to literal plus/hyphen sequences inside quoted string; but root JSON valid. The error is because we expect args to be a JSON object, not a string. When client double-stringified and also included UTF7-escapes, the runtime rejects schema.

devx: Short term fix: accept string args if they parse to JSON after replacing common modified-UTF7 tokens -> risky. Long term: enforce SDK client to normalize. Ask SDK team to add preflight sanitizer.

ian-qa: For support, suggested repro steps:
1) Save payload.json in Notepad++ with encoding "UTF-7"
2) curl -d @payload.json
3) Observe 400 with message: "invalid_tool_args: args must be object"
Also attach sample sanitized payload.

lina: Workaround that worked for me: run `iconv -f UTF-7 -t UTF-8 payload.json > payload.utf8.json` then curl using payload.utf8.json. That fixed it.

max: Filed support ticket #INC-2026, tagging SDK:devx and docs:devex. Recommend adding client-side validation + clear error suggesting "possible modified-UTF7 or pasted-from-mail client."

support-bot: :thumbsup: Added to backlog and set priority P2.
